text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, your tie is a little crooked. 
...Ah, right there. That will do.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
First, we greet the host. 
Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Party Host
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I look forward to seeing more from you! 
Truly the great hope of an athletic bloodline! 
Now, how about showing us that talent of yours?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: --Meaning what, exactly?

text_block_list.name: Party Host
text_block_list.text:
We've arranged fencing for the entertainment. 
As it happens, another horsegirl is here tonight. 
And she's the hope of her own bloodline, just like you!

text_block_list.name: Party Host
text_block_list.text:
In that case, a match between two great hopes would be splendid, no? 
--What do you say, Lady Rose Kingdom?
choice_data_list: Rose Kingdom. So you're here too
Rose Kingdom. So you're here too

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
If that is your wish.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
For me, of an athletic bloodline, 
refusal is out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The strength my family has cultivated-- 
please, behold it.

A great many guests had gathered around the stage 
to watch the two of them. Yet the pair stood in a tension 
far removed from all that clamor.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
We both carry our families on our backs. 
I will show no mercy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: That is as it should be.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(A beautiful stance. Supple, elegant. 
And... not a single opening.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I can tell just by facing her. 
She is highly skilled--!

It was over in an instant. 
Rose Kingdom's point struck 
above Duramente's waist. A score.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Fencing originated in France. 
The founder of the rose family was French as well... 
Which means I cannot afford to lose either.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I must show them. 
That the Kingdom of Roses stands here!

A fierce exchange. Even knowing they use safe practice foils 
and wear protective gear beneath their clothes, 
it's enough to set your heart racing.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (For all that elegance, her attacks are razor-sharp--!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Fencing is a sport that prizes chivalry. 
So it isn't elegance alone--there's substance behind it.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Otherwise she would not have come this far. 
She has kept on fighting--so this is the rose family!)

Rose Kingdom unleashes a flurry of high-speed thrusts. 
Duramente, defending, cannot turn to the attack.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(But... my family too 
exists at the end of a long fight.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Faster, stronger, forever chasing the summit. 
And so... I am the crystal of that blood.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
For me to lose is to sully all my family's striving...! 
I will not allow it...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I will prove it-- I am the crystal of that blood!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Rrraaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Host and Guests
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaaaa! The intensity of a real duel!" 
"Go on, both of you!" "I can't seeee!"

The guests roared with excitement too. 
So many were packed together that 
the deck swayed a little with their fervor.

When I turned my eyes from the crowd back to the stage, 
a dark shadow fell across my vision--

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ?! Knocked over by the shaking...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer, get down!
(Shff--! --Crash!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...That was a close thing. 
Thank goodness...

The vase lay shattered some distance away. 
Duramente had leapt from the stage in a single bound 
and swept it aside with her foil.
choice_data_list: Thank you. But I interrupted the match...
Thank you. But I interrupted the match...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The fencing? 
...Without you, proving myself the crystal of that blood

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
would mean nothing. 
That is what I believe, at least.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
So that is where the speed came from. 
The reason I fell behind.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
In respect of that bond. 
The victory is yours.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It was an honor to cross blades with you, 
Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Rose was strong. 
I lost all composure and threw myself into it.
choice_data_list: That wildness of yours looked amazing
That was the strongest, all right!

text_block_list.text:
Rose Kingdom, every inch the prince, 
and Duramente, wild and fierce. I told them each 
had a splendor all their own.
choice_data_list: The Dura who came to save me was like a knight

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A knight... So that is how I looked to you. 
Heh, I see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Then I managed to protect both 
my claim to being the strongest and my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That said, Rose did give me a hard fight. 
I must train harder still.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If I kept my family's honor intact, that's a relief. 
...And now that I'm relieved, I'm hungry.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this food is too good to waste. 
Let's enjoy it together.
